blocks.x: Good? Kennith Kimery: You are great and we are going.

Okay, in this last hour of the oral history interview with Jimmy Owens, we are going to discuss this award of the NEA jazz master. You are the first jazz musician ever to receive this jazz advocacy award. The previous honorees were in the business. We had a recording engineer, we had…
We had George Wein. We had…what was his name? Kennith Kimery: George Avakian
Yeah, and the recording engineer who did all the Blue Note records. Kennith Kimery: Rudy Van Gelder

Rudy Van Gelder, thank you so much. You know other people have been placed in that category of jazz advocates, but you are the first jazz musician to be in that category of both NEA Jazz Master musician and jazz advocate. So, so say whatever you would really like to say about this.
